outcome: Enable banks, insurers, and fintechs to approve genuine digital customers faster while detecting forged documents, synthetic identities, deepfakes, and high-risk devices.
overview: Digital onboarding must convert genuine customers quickly while stopping forged documents, synthetic identities, deepfakes and high-risk devices. This solution orchestrates the whole journey: consent-led capture, document validation, biometric and liveness checks, device intelligence, trusted-source lookups, sanctions and PEP screening, and risk-based decisioning — approving low-risk applicants automatically and routing uncertain cases to trained reviewers with reason codes. Arabic and English journeys are supported, with in-country deployment for UAE and KSA residency. A 6–10-week proof of value runs on synthetic journeys and approved historical outcomes, targeting higher straight-through onboarding, lower abandonment and manual effort, and a complete consent and decision evidence trail.

benefits.text: Increase straight-through, policy-compliant onboarding by a target 15–30%
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Target range to validate against the customer’s own journey analytics during the PoV — not a guarantee

benefits.text: Reduce manual review by a target 25–40%, lowering cost per approved customer
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Depends on document and country coverage and on the customer’s acceptance policy

benefits.text: Capture consent, decision and evidence records for 100% of applications, strengthening KYC audit posture
benefits.source: Reference-design control (consent and decision logging); Redington BFSI catalogue
benefits.limits: An evidence-capture control, not a claim that every accepted identity is genuine

residency: Deployable in-country on local AWS or Azure regions (e.g. UAE, KSA); a hybrid option retains biometric evidence on customer-approved infrastructure where privacy rules demand it

notFor.situation: No lawful basis or approved consent model for biometric processing
notFor.why: Liveness and face-match checks process biometric data; without a documented lawful basis and retention policy the journey cannot go live

notFor.situation: Required identity documents or issuing countries are outside verification coverage
notFor.why: Document and trusted-source coverage determines pass rates; forcing unsupported documents through inflates false rejects and manual queues

notFor.situation: No trained manual-review team for exceptions
notFor.why: The design routes uncertain and high-risk applications to humans; without reviewers those applicants are simply lost

scope:
Model: Joint delivery: accredited implementation partner leads, with Redington architecture and commercial governance; the customer owns KYC acceptance policy and privacy approval · Duration: 6–10 weeks PoV; 12–22 weeks to production
Delivery pod: Partner delivery and UX leads + project manager, identity-vendor specialist; customer digital product owner, KYC/fraud owner, privacy officer, security approver, mobile/web lead and operations manager · Support model: Business-hours or 24×7 platform support with severity-based targets; partner first line with identity-provider escalation; optional managed review
1) Discovery, journey and risk design
2) Trusted-source onboarding
3) Build and integration
4) Security, privacy and accessibility testing
5) Reviewer training and UAT
6) Controlled launch, stabilisation and handover
